name: Moskito Island
positioning: The Branson Beach Estate on Moskito Island: three Balinese-style villas with a private beach on the northeast tip of the island in the British Virgin Islands
best_for: Extended families and groups wanting villas linked by walkways around a private beach
Travelers who want a private villa with its own infinity pool and sea views

facts.text: The Branson Beach Estate sits on a dramatic outcrop at the northeast tip of Moskito Island, with elevated sea views.
The Branson Beach Estate is about two miles from Necker Island.
The estate is made up of three standalone villas connected by elevated wooden walkways.
The three villas are Headland House, Mangrove Villa and Beach Villa.
The villas are in a Balinese style.
The estate has its own private beach.
Headland House sits at the heart of the estate and has sea views from all bedrooms.
Beach Villa sits in a sheltered position just above a sandy beach, with views to the Caribbean Sea, and has direct access to a private sandy beach.
The estate offers walking trails and two tennis courts.
The estate's resident chef plans menus tailored to each guest's needs and tastes, from local Caribbean specialities to international dishes.
The estate's team helps organise events, from intimate ceremonies to milestone birthdays.

highlights.text: Headland House has a wraparound infinity pool.
Mangrove Villa is nestled among mangrove trees and faces east towards Necker Island and Virgin Gorda.
The estate's standalone Balinese-style villas look out at its private beach and the sea.
Moskito Island has grass tennis courts with stadium seating.

considerations.text: Moskito Island is approximately 30 minutes by boat from Tortola, the nearest international airport.
The estate is next to Moskito Island's communal recreational facilities.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires private transportation and the property is booked by contacting WhataHotel rather than online.
